ext_description.message: An assistant for backtesting trading strategies and showing external signals in Tradingview

popup_whats_new_title.message: Close and do not show again

popup_tv_english_html.message: The extension works with the English version of TradingView

popup_error_not_tv_html.message: To work with the extension, activate it on the tab with the opened TradingView chart.

popup_filter_label.message: Filter to use the best results corresponding to the parameters:

popup_tf_label.message: Backtesting the strategy on timeframes (divided by comma)

popup_tf_title.message: Set list of timeframes, where symbol format is: 1m - minutes, 2h - hours, 3D - days, 4W - weeks, 5M - months

popup_cycles_hint.message: The recommendation is to use around 100-200 cycles or less per test.

popup_run_desc.message: Run a user-controlled strategy test using the loaded or generated parameter range.

popup_deep_note.message: Deep backtesting (for TV premium subscription) currently works as standard backtesting. Activate it manually.

popup_template_desc.message: Getting a template for setting the testing parameters of the current strategy.

popup_upload_csv_lead.message: To test the profit of strategies, upload a CSV file in which the lines correspond to the strategy parameters and contain the testing range.

popup_preview_desc.message: Quick overview of the results of the last testing for this ticker and timeframe.

popup_download_desc.message: To download the results of the last testing for this ticker and timeframe.

popup_3d_desc.message: View a 3D chart with the results

popup_signals_step1.message: To display the signals, you need to create a pine script named 'iondvSignals' from the

popup_signals_step2.message: and add it to the chart. After that, upload the signals from the file created by the

popup_signals_step3.message: . The signals are stored in the browser, to activate them, open the properties of the created indicator named 'iondvSignals'.

popup_delay_desc.message: Delay between backtests to reduce continuous TradingView UI activity and lower the risk of suspicious account activity.

popup_delay_random.message: Random delay for the specified value

popup_loading_desc.message: The maximum waiting time for data of the strategy, if the results table has not been updated (2 times more if used for deep backtesting). Reduce to speed up on simple strategies, increase it if data extraction errors happen often.

popup_skip_best_desc.message: Skip initial best parameters from the previous backtest.

popup_extra_tabs_desc.message: Also parse the report tabs for metrics missing from TradingView data (CAGR, expectancy, outliers, streaks, periodical, time patterns). Slower: every tab is opened on each backtest. Applies only when the report is read from TradingView data (the fast mode). When the extension falls back to parsing the report page, all tabs are parsed anyway and this option is ignored.

popup_api_desc.message: Experimental, faster: set strategy parameters through the TradingView chart API instead of the strategy dialog. Risk: TradingView may change this API without notice (the test then falls back to the dialog), and automated use of it may violate TradingView terms and could lead to account restrictions. Use at your own risk.

popup_skip_wait_desc.message: Download results without waiting for a click on the OK button.

popup_research_desc.message: Opens the DZ23 research view: turns the results CSV into a Top N, a parameter heatmap and a validated experiment (JSON).

popup_copilot_desc.message: Opens the DZ23 copilot in the side panel: conversations with the AI provider you configure in the local gateway.

popup_help_issues_rest.message: : attach a full screenshot of the TradingView page and, if possible, the browser console output (F12, Console tab).

popup_method_random_dd.message: Selects random values for all parameters at once on every test.

popup_method_random_improvement_dd.message: Changes one random parameter to a random value from its whole range. A better result becomes the new state, and the next changes start from it.

popup_method_sequential_dd.message: Improves the best state already found, one parameter at a time: all values of the first parameter are checked, the best one is kept, then the next parameter is checked, and so on. It does not search the whole parameter space.

popup_method_annealing_dd.message: Finds a good result in fewer steps. It starts from the best state and changes parameters to random values; a better result becomes the new state. As the tests go on, the spread of values narrows ("cools down") around the best values found: first it explores the whole space, at the end it refines the best state. From time to time it changes all parameters at once, so it does not get stuck in one area like the sequential method.

popup_method_bruteforce_dd.message: Tests every combination of values in the parameter space.

popup_help_more_html.message: More details in the project documentation.

popup_footer.message: Automated use of TradingView may violate its rules and lead to an account ban. The extension does not bypass its protections but repeats UI actions: use it carefully, at your own risk.
